title: QuantumTrade19
explain: A lightweight desktop app that watches CoinDCX futures prices, finds key price levels (POIs), spots the 123Bull and 123Bear candle setups around them, scores them, alerts you, and later places trades by hand and then automatically.

title: Phase 1 - Foundation: see, detect, alert (Files 01-09)
explain: Everything needed to watch the market, find setups and warn you. No trading yet.

title: Phase 2 - Manual trading (Files 10-12)
explain: You press Buy or Sell; the app calculates risk, stop loss, take profit and lot size for you.

title: Phase 3 - Automatic trading (Files 13-14)
explain: The app places and manages trades by itself when a setup passes your confidence threshold.

title: Phase 4 - Learning (Files 15-16)
explain: The app studies past trades and suggests better settings.

title: Phase 5 - Intelligence (Files 17-18)
explain: Machine-learning helpers that advise but never block live trading.

title: Final - Packaging (File 19)
explain: Makes a Windows and Mac installable app, with tray icon and startup options.

title: Post-File-04 roadmap (Tracks 2-6)
explain: Extra features and fixes that were designed after File 04: visual fixes, scanner, callouts, multi-window, backfill.

title: Tooling - Project Operations and Project Status
explain: The request tool, the watcher and this status page. They help us build, not part of the trading app.

title: FT-1 Confidence Score (File 05)
explain: The 'referee': 20 small judges each score a confirmed setup; the total out of 100 decides whether it is worth acting on (default minimum 65). Needed first because both the Discord alert and the auto system use the score.

title: Pattern group: wick rejection, POI stack, POI tier, MTF read
explain: Four pattern-based judges. Engulfing and FVG scores come straight from Setup Detection.

title: Momentum, trend, overbought/oversold, volatility
explain: RSI/MACD, ADX/EMA slope and ATR percentile judges.

title: Volume, order-book and funding judges
explain: Order-book and funding switch themselves off for symbols or feeds where they do not apply.

title: Time-edge and risk judges
explain: Session, weekday and hour judges stay neutral until the journal has enough history. Also RR path, news blackout, spread.

title: ConfidenceScorer: rescale, threshold, keep the breakdown
explain: Sums active judges, rescales to 100 when any are switched off, compares with the threshold, and keeps the full breakdown for the journal.

title: Gate: 20 synthetic setups give exact scores; each filter OFF in turn
explain: The acceptance test for FT-1. You confirm before lock.

title: FT-2 Quantity calculator (File 10, reduced)
explain: Works out how big the trade should be from your risk amount and the stop-loss distance, with fees included. Needed before the Discord alert because the message shows quantity.

title: Fee estimator (maker/taker plus GST)
explain: Round-trip fee cost per symbol.

title: Tick table
explain: Stored tick size per symbol; warns you when one changes.

title: Stop-loss source: setup candles (default) or a price you type, with a switch
explain: Decision A (22-10-2026): both options, with a switch. Default is the SL found from the setup candles.

title: Lot-size worker with per-symbol leverage
explain: Quantity = risk amount divided by stop distance, respecting leverage and tick size.

title: Gate: hand-worked examples match exactly
explain: The acceptance test for FT-2.

title: FT-3 Discord trade alerts (File 06, reduced)

title: Message template
explain: One readable shape for every alert.

title: Discord notifier: several webhooks, on/off switch

title: Pacing queue so bursts never hit rate limits
explain: Prevents Discord 429 errors during busy moments.

title: Alerts tab list, newest first
explain: Every fired alert is listed in the Alerts tab.

title: Gate: 2+ webhooks and a 20-alert burst, no drops or duplicates
explain: The acceptance test for FT-3.

title: FT-4 Paper broker account

title: Virtual account: balance, equity, margin, free margin

title: Broker factors with defaults

title: Ledger: positions, fills, realized and unrealized PnL
explain: Never touches the real broker.

title: Settings card with editable defaults and reset
explain: Matches the locked UI style.

title: Gate: fabricated-price round trip matches a hand calculation
explain: The acceptance test for FT-4.

title: FT-5 Minimum journal (File 07, reduced)
explain: Trade, day, X-day, week, X-week, month and X-month overviews with KPI cards.

title: Trade logger (paper/live tag, auto/manual source)
explain: Every trade with entry, SL, TP, quantity, exit reason and net PnL.

title: Aggregator for all the period views
explain: Updates incrementally as trades are added.

title: KPI cards and equity curve
explain: Win rate, net PnL, profit factor, average R, drawdown, best and worst.

title: Gate: 20 simulated trades; totals equal the sum of the trades
explain: The acceptance test for FT-5.

title: FT-6 Execution and manual Trading Panel (Files 11-12)
explain: The 'hands': a Paper/Live router, fills with slippage guard, position tracking, trailing stop and the opposite-setup exit.

title: Mode router: Paper / Live toggle
explain: Routes each order to the paper simulator or the real broker.

title: Paper simulator on FT-4, order placement, fill and slippage guard
explain: A fill that slips too far is rejected and logged.

title: Position manager, TP methods, trailing SL, opposite-setup exit
explain: The single source of truth for open positions.

title: Gate: 20 manual paper trades, SL/TP match FT-2 exactly
explain: The acceptance test for FT-6.

title: FT-7 Auto trade with a Paper/Live switch (Files 13-14)
explain: The software places trades by itself when the score passes. Real money is switched on only after a soak test.

title: Manual/Auto switch per symbol (default Manual)
explain: A symbol trades itself only after you flip it to Auto.

title: Circuit breaker, max-concurrent guard, Dry-Run (default ON)
explain: Safety nets: auto falls back to alerts when a data engine is unhealthy; Dry-Run sends even 'Live' orders to paper.

title: Soak test in Paper/Dry-Run (blueprint: 1 week, 3+ symbols)
explain: The only waiting period in the plan; it protects real money.

title: Live switch: smallest risk first, then scale
explain: At least one more week at the smallest risk setting before full size.
